name: Favorite Button
description: Compact toggle button with a star icon that launches out of the button, flips, drops back in and settles active, with a squash bounce and elastic hole effect.
contents: Button with animated star icon and text label
behavior: Click toggles an active state with a GSAP keyframe animation of the star jumping, dropping in, rotating and bouncing
Clicks are ignored while the animation runs
Button background squeezes slightly while pressed
editableByProps: Button, text, star, face and hole colors

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the animation timing or star jump height

fixed: Root fills the viewport height and centers its content. Override with className using an important modifier such as !h-auto.
Toggle state is kept through DOM classes and is not exposed to the parent
